items.t: General Motors Is Up 11% in a Month as the Nasdaq-100 Fell 10%. Is Its Nasdaq Switch Really That Good?
items.sum: Key TakeawaysGeneral Motors stock is up 11% in the past month, mostly on its move to Nasdaq, while the Nasdaq-100 fell 10%. Ford’s higher profit floor and a shift out of Tesla helped too, but Ford expects flat 2027 profit.

items.t: General Motors (GM) Bets On Egypt Assembly And Wider EV Charging Access
items.sum: General Motors (NasdaqGS:GM) is starting local production of the Chevrolet Groove in Egypt with a strong local sourcing commitment. The automaker is also broadening its collaboration with Tesla by adopting the NACS charging standard for GM electric vehicles in South Korea.
